messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation.
The recorded demand forecast for part:340010 changed by +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).
Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is EUR 24.31 per price unit (cost:340010).
Your recorded on-time delivery rate is 79.5 % (sc:70410@2026Q3).
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 23,400 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

As a matter of corporate policy, we do not disclose internal cost breakdowns. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. 

We have incorporated your requested volume of 23,400 pieces and the 24-month contract duration into our revised proposal. We must maintain a lead time of 54 days, as the expedited schedules you proposed carry substantial premiums.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our current Angebot is a price of €33.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.90 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

Our offer is valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
